definitions.explanation: Expresses strong certainty that something will happen.
Indicates that something happens every time without exception.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧{必|かなら}ず⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{必|かなら}ず⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功：02638_seikou⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必|かなら}ず⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{必|かなら}ず⟦{戸締|とじ}まり→戸締まり：17821_tojimari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I always lock up before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧{必|かなら}ず⟦{報|むく}われる→報いる：12088_mukuiru⟧。
examples.english: If you make an effort, you will surely be rewarded.

examples.english: Make sure to contact me, okay?

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{必|かなら}ず⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I always read the newspaper in the morning.

examples.japanese: {必|かなら}ずしも⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。

examples.english: I always wash my hands before meals.

notes:
{必|かなら}ず is an adverb expressing certainty or 'without exception.'

Position: Usually appears before the verb, often near the beginning of the clause.

Modifies: Verbs (both actions and states)

Similar adverbs:
- {必|かなら}ず vs. ⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧: Both express certainty. {必|かなら}ず emphasizes 'without fail' (100% certainty); きっと expresses confident expectation (high probability but not absolute).
- {必|かなら}ず vs. ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧): {絶対|ぜったい}に is more emphatic and casual; {必|かなら}ず is more neutral.
- {必|かなら}ず vs. ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: いつも simply means 'always'; {必|かなら}ず adds emphasis on 'without exception.'

Note: Often used in instructions, promises, and warnings to emphasize importance.
